$description: The shared body/action grammar inside an operation depth (#3137). The surface primitive owns close/Back, focus, dismissal and stacking — see pattern.overlay-surfaces and #3089 — while this block records the body constraint: one scrolling body, wrapped content, one action line, and App actions at the touch floor. `controlHeightToken` names the Experience band shared control/actions resolve; `parts` maps the recipe's stable data-recipe-part anatomy to its typography role (#3138). On App the visible operation name is the host page header's title (the recipe places the host header), so the app block has no operation-title part.
